name: com.classicspins.pf-firebase-rc
description: PrototypeFramework service module: Firebase Remote Config behind IRemoteConfigSource (replaces the framework's fake source). The framework's RemoteFetch boot node calls it; the values land in the framework's config layer and its cache. Firebase keys cannot hold a dot, so a game key 'a.b_c' is read from the Firebase parameter 'a_b_c'. Without the Firebase SDK installed every fetch is refused and logged; the bundled defaults stay.
